items.title: Waive Notice
notes:
Prior to beginning the Special Council meeting this date, it was noted Council was being requested to Waive Notice to amend the start time of the meeting this date to accommodate the addition of an urgent agenda matter.

To approve the amended start time, 2/3 of the Whole of Council is required.

items.title: Commencement
notes:
A meeting of City Council was held at 5:02 p.m. this date, chaired by Acting Mayor A. Owodunni. Notice of this meeting had been previously given to all members of Council by the City Clerk pursuant to Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code.

The meeting began with a Land Acknowledgement given by the Mayor.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
Mayoral Business and Updates - Mayor B. Vrbanovic
Waive Notice
notes:
It was requested to waive notice to add an additional urgent matter related to City Arts Program (Land Disposition and Solicitor-Client Privilege- Section 239 (c) and (f) of the Municipal Act, 2001, to the in-camera meeting later this date.

To approve the additional urgent matter on the agenda, 2/3 of members present is required.

items.title: To confirm all actions and proceedings of the Council for September 18, 2023.
Adjournment
notes: On motion the meeting adjourned at 5:05 p.m.
